schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Server workspaces pin exact versions (ADR-0015). .npmrc sets save-exact=true; this keeps Renovate from widening a pin back to a range.
Never group updates. Lockfile diffs are reviewed as code (ADR-0015), and a batched PR is the one nobody reads line by line.
The database, the pooler and the object store are pinned deliberately and moved on purpose. Major bumps stay manual.
Security fixes bypass the 7-day quarantine. The window exists because hijacked versions are yanked within days; a published advisory is the case the window was not protecting against.
